summary.headline: Behind target on both orders (90.0%) and revenue (91.3%) this week, with the quarter and year also behind target; cancellations rose notably.

points.what: Orders rose 9.9% WoW and 58.5% YoY, a notable move outside the recent range, but reached only 90.0% of the weekly target.
points.so_what: Strong growth on both bases still wasn't enough to close the gap to this week's target.

points.what: Revenue fell 0.7% WoW to $50,652, reaching 91.3% of the weekly target.
points.so_what: The week missed target on revenue too, alongside the miss on orders.

points.what: QTD revenue attainment stands at 85.5% and YTD revenue attainment is also 85.5%, both behind target.
points.so_what: The quarter and year are both trailing target, not just this single week.

points.what: Cancellation rate jumped 5.4pp WoW to 16.8%, a notable increase rated bad.
points.so_what: This flags cancellations as a fresh risk to revenue quality heading into next week.

points.what: Cancellation rate rose 5.4pp WoW to 16.8%, a notable increase rated bad.
points.so_what: Each percentage point of cancellations equals $609 in revenue, so this increase adds meaningful pressure on an already behind-target week.

points.what: The 14-Day Return Rate for the week of Jan 5 was 11.2%, flat WoW but up 0.7pp YoY, a bad-direction move.
points.so_what: Returns not improving year over year point to an ongoing drag on effective revenue beyond this single week.

points.what: The current 8-week revenue run-rate is $50,757, well below the $75,250 per week required for the rest of the year to hit the full-year target.
points.so_what: At the recent pace, the full-year revenue target is out of reach.

points.what: Weekly orders attainment was 90.0% and weekly revenue attainment was 91.3%, both behind target.
points.so_what: Both orders and revenue missed this week's target despite YoY growth in each.

points.what: QTD revenue attainment is 85.5%, behind target, with $572,982 still needed to reach the full-quarter target.
points.so_what: The quarter needs a stronger pace over its remaining weeks to close this gap.

points.what: YTD revenue attainment is 85.5%, behind target, requiring a $75,250 weekly run-rate for the rest of the year versus a current 8-week run-rate of $50,757.
points.so_what: The current pace is well below what's needed, putting the full-year target out of reach unless pace increases.

points.what: Search was the biggest driver of the week's order growth, contributing 38 orders and 56.7% of the total change WoW.
points.so_what: Most of the week's order growth was concentrated in one traffic source rather than spread evenly across channels.

points.what: North America was the biggest regional driver, contributing 20 orders and 29.9% of the change WoW.
points.so_what: Regional growth was more broadly spread than traffic-source growth, with North America leading among four contributing regions.

points.what: AOV fell 3.7% WoW to $81.7, a notable decline, though still up 0.8% YoY.
points.so_what: The revenue dip this week reflects smaller order values rather than fewer orders, since orders themselves rose WoW.

points.what: The 14-Day Return Rate for the week of Jan 5 was 11.2%, flat WoW but up 0.7pp YoY.
points.so_what: Returns are not improving year over year, adding a steady drag on effective revenue alongside this week's cancellation increase.

points.what: New signups rose 6.0% WoW to 247, below orders' 9.9% WoW growth.
points.so_what: New customer signups grew more slowly than overall orders this week on a WoW basis.
